messages:
adele: Quick sync — consolidating post-incident action items for the streaming/chat flakiness (timeouts, partials, reconnects). Want to set a recurring short remediation standup and lock owners.

miki: +1. I can own the reconnect/backoff changes. Will propose a concrete retry window.

samir: I’ll take the client-side partial-response stitching logic and tests. Found a reproducible case in staging yesterday.

julia: I’ll handle observability: timeout histogram, partial-chunk counter, and a dashboard. Will add alerts that map to severity.

adele: Cool — let’s make timelines explicit: owners, ticket IDs, and a targeted ship week. Short cadence (twice-weekly) until incidents fall below our SLO.

miki: Plan from my side: RFC by Tue, PR by Fri. Ticket: INF-2145. Changes: increase handshake retries, jittered exponential backoff, and a guard to avoid duplicate reconnections.

samir: Ticket INF-2146. I’ll add unit + e2e tests that simulate socket pauses and truncated frames. Test harness notes: `pytest tests/streaming/test_reconnect.py::test_truncated_frame`.

julia: Ticket INF-2147. Dashboard: `streams.latency.p50/p95`, `streams.partial_count`, `streams/handshake_retries`. Pager threshold proposal: partial_count > 10/min for 5m.

adele: Great. Ricardo — can you confirm dedicated infra capacity for blue/green tests? We need a spike generator for partials.

ricardo: I’ve reserved a small pool for pressure tests next Wed. Will add a script in infra repo: `infra/tools/stream-spike.sh`.

ops-bot: Created task INF-2145, INF-2146, INF-2147 and linked to incident-789. Owner tags added.

miki: Regarding rollout policy: canary to 5% with automatic rollback if `streams.partial_count` increases by >20% vs baseline. I’ll add the rollout config to the dedicated deploy job.

samir: Note on client stitch: we should add sequence checks and KV-cache expiry bump for resumed sessions. That should reduce duplication and partials.

julia: Also adding a synthetic nightly job that opens 500 concurrent streams and performs randomized network drops to validate reconnect logic.

adele: Ownership + deadlines recap: miki (reconnect/backoff) — RFC Tue, PR Fri, ship next Tue. samir (stitch/tests) — tests by Thu, PR Mon. julia (dash/alerts) — dashboard by Thu. ricardo (infra for load) — spike script by Mon.

miki: Will post a short RFC link in this thread when ready.

samir: I’ll paste repro steps in INF-2146 and note the staging run that failed.

julia: Adding dashboards to /monitoring/dashboards/streams and will attach links.

adele: Let’s meet 15m every Mon/Wed 09:30 PT until all items are closed. Invite sent. If owners want to escalate to daily, ping me.

ops-bot: Reminder: next standup scheduled 1754381400 (Mon 09:30 PT).

adele: One more ask — capture any recurrence patterns in the ticket (time of day, client binary version, region). This helps catch long-tail causes.

samir: Will include client version and last-successful-seq in test metadata.

miki: Also flag quantization/compilation changes as a potential regression vector — I’ll run a quick diff of kernel selection logs for the canary.

julia: If alerts start firing, we’ll escalate to incident channel and follow the oncall runbook.

adele: Thanks team. I’ll keep the tracker updated and close the loop after two green standups. :thumbsup:

ricardo: FYI I added a lightweight playbook to the infra repo `docs/streaming/fail-mode-checklist.md` for oncall runbook references.

ops-bot: INF-2145 status updated -> in_progress.

miki: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/842 (reconnect), marking for review.

samir: Staging run results uploaded to the ticket — reproduces partials when latency spikes > 250ms for 10s.

julia: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/stream-health (will request share perms).

adele: Good progress. Next update in the standup. If anyone hits blockers, mention me directly.
